notes.title: First update is published
notes.content:
We just published an update to make "I Hate Santa" better, a few highlights below.

* Add achievements supports 
* Polished the game ending to make the plot less obscure ( thanks for all the feedback)
* Polished the jet pack dropper, if you can hit them, you will get a nice surprise now ( it's not easy:) )
* Fix a bunch of visual glitches on game tips / leader board 

Happy holiday, have fun!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27021068/36face974c607beab0fdb60b69fe907356df8e12.jpg[/img][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27021068/1c861507b4fb86951d5f8bb9837ec7f9db969812.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Thanks and post-launch update announcement
notes.content:
Thanks everyone who played the game, and thanks for all the feedback and reviews.

We knew from day one, this game won't give us meaningful financial returns, especially comparing with our  daily job incomes.

However, we had fun when making this game, and now even more, we received a lot of very positive feedback , which is ... touching.

So happy to see people founding out the little tricks in the game.
So happy to see people sharing game-play video on YouTube
So happy to see people fighting for leader-board position


We have decided We are going to keep improving this game even sales drop to zero someday,  our 1st update will come end of this week, stay tune!
